messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xxs and gateway timeouts detected for /v1/generate (us-west-2). 5m error rate = 12%, 95th latency = 3.2s, backend batcher queue depth rising. Auto-pager sent to oncall.
paul (oncall): on it. Paging SREs. seeing batcher queue length trending up on the /batcher/* pods. head-of-line blocking looks likely.
daria: I can see a lot of `batch_window_ms=50` on the batcher config. requests are accumulating into big batches and some long-running requests are stalling the queue.
ken: quick check of HPA and pod CPU/memory:
```
kubectl -n inference get hpa batcher
NAME     REFERENCE            TARGETS  MINPODS  MAXPODS  REPLICAS
batcher  Deployment/batcher    95%/80%     4        12        9
kubectl -n inference top pods | grep batcher
batcher-7f5c  1800m  6Gi
batcher-8d9a  1700m  6Gi
```
ken: CPU is pegged, replicas near max. also seeing KV-cache growth on some pods.
paul (oncall): suspected root cause: sustained surge -> scheduler/batcher saturates -> head-of-line blocking -> gateway timeouts & 5xx. Need immediate mitigation: 1) reduce batch window 2) emergency scale 3) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant 4) evict long-running requests.
nina: I'm toggling the batch window to 20ms for the impacted pool now (will push to canary then all).
```
# patch batching config
curl -XPATCH https://control-plane/api/v1/configs/batcher -d '{"batch_window_ms":20}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
daria: applying to canary pods... rolling patch started.
sre-lead: also recommend disabling prefix caching for this class temporarily (some caches are causing uneven batch sizes).
paul (oncall): scaling cluster nodes and batcher deployment in parallel. doing `kubectl scale deployment/batcher --replicas=16 -n inference`.
```
kubectl scale deployment/batcher --replicas=16 -n inference
```
ops-bot: autoscaling request accepted, cloud provider scaling activity in progress. ETA ~80s for nodes.
maria (customer-success): CS heads — we have alerts from 3 enterprise customers (acme-inc, acme-analytics, bluebank) reporting increased timeouts and 5xx errors. I've let them know we're investigating and provided a brief note. Will update if any SLO breaches are reported.
ken: as nodes come up, I'm also enabling a short-term eviction of requests older than 30s on batcher to unblock head-of-line:
```
curl -XPOST http://batcher-admin/api/v1/evict -d '{"older_than_s":30}'
```
nina: eviction command issued to canary group, logs show successful evictions and backlog decreasing. errors trending down but still spiky.
gateway-bot: emergency routing enabled: route heavy/long requests to rdx-medium-quant (lower latency but slightly lower quality).
sre-lead: adding circuit-breaker threshold for gateway to shed new large requests at 20% error spike to protect control plane.
paul (oncall): checking metrics: error rate now 3.8% (was 12%). p95 latency down to 1.1s. queue depth half of peak.
maria (customer-success): sending customers interim status: "We've implemented emergency routing and scaled capacity; errors are reduced and we're monitoring. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline for fixes."
ken: logs after mitigations, sample trace:
```
[2026-06-05T18:04:12Z] batcher-7f5c request_id=abc123 queue_time=2.8s process_time=1.2s result=evicted
[2026-06-05T18:04:14Z] batcher-8d9a request_id=def456 queue_time=0.3s process_time=0.8s result=200
```
nina: adding follow-ups: create replayable prompt set to reproduce the tail requests, and add a batching-quality regression alert to catch future config-induced spikes.
sre-lead: next steps for postmortem: 1) root cause analysis of why batcher didn't backpressure earlier 2) tune default batch_window/autoscale thresholds 3) KV-cache GC improvements 4) run chaos test for surge patterns.
paul (oncall): assigning follow-ups to eng-runner and eng-runtime. If error rate stays <5% for 30m we'll hand back to standard ops.
ops-bot: Deploy/patch completed — batch_window and eviction tool applied to 100% of impacted pool.
paul (oncall): thanks team. I'll keep monitoring for 30m. anyone see customer regressions after notification?
maria (customer-success): one customer opened a severity-2 ticket but accepted the interim mitigation. I'll coordinate RCA comms.
ken: leaving a snippet for rotation: if we see this pattern again, immediate playbook: reduce batch_window -> evict >30s -> enable fallback model -> scale replicas. document those exact commands in the runbook.
paul (oncall): closing pager in 30m if stable. great work. :thumbsup:
